data.one_liner: A widget that prevents unnecessary child widget rebuilds by customizing rebuild conditions.
data.what_it_does: It provides a generic ShouldRebuild widget that filters out unnecessary child widget rebuilds based on whether property values between the old and new child widgets are equal. The Todo widget or any specified child only rebuilds if the defined condition is met.
use_when: You want to optimize performance by avoiding unnecessary rebuilds of child widgets.
You need custom comparison logic to determine if a child widget should update based on its properties.
avoid_when: You are already using state management solutions that handle rebuild optimization out of the box.
Your widget tree is simple and performance optimization is not a concern.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API to implement conditional rebuilding.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic usage examples.
Requires manual specification of rebuild conditions for widgets.
data.minimal_example:
ShouldRebuild<Todo>(
    shouldRebuild: (oldWidget, newWidget) => oldWidget.counter != newWidget.counter,
    child: Todo(counter: counter,)
)
